quranTranslation.text: Lo! man was created anxious,

explanation.bs: Opisuje se ljudska narav – nestrpljivost s kojom je čovjek stvoren.
explanation.en: Human nature is described — the restlessness man was created with.

quranTranslation.text: Allah would make the burden light for you, for man was created weak.

explanation.bs: Slabost kao crta ljudske prirode.
explanation.en: Weakness as a trait of human nature.

quranTranslation.text: Man prayeth for evil as he prayeth for good; for man was ever hasty.

explanation.bs: Brzopletost – još jedna osobina koju Kur'an pripisuje čovjeku kao takvom.
explanation.en: Haste — another trait the Quran ascribes to man as such.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,

explanation.bs: Stvaranje čovjekova tijela od ilovače – tjelesna strana, zato بَشَر.
explanation.en: The creation of man's body from clay — the bodily side, hence bashar.

quranTranslation.text: Say: I am only a mortal like you. My Lord inspireth in me that your Allah is only One Allah. And whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work, and make none sharer of the worship due unto his Lord.

explanation.bs: Poslanik je čovjek, smrtnik kao i oni kojima se obraća; razlikuje ga objava koja mu dolazi.
explanation.en: The Prophet is a man, mortal like those he addresses; what sets him apart is the revelation he receives.

quranTranslation.text: And of His signs is this: He created you of dust, and behold you human beings, ranging widely!

explanation.bs: Od zemlje stvoreni, ljudi postaju tjelesna bića koja se rasprostiru po zemlji.
explanation.en: Created from dust, people become bodily beings spreading over the earth.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! Be careful of your duty to your Lord Who created you from a single soul and from it created its mate and from them twain hath spread abroad a multitude of men and women. Be careful of your duty toward Allah in Whom ye claim (your rights) of one another, and toward the wombs (that bare you). Lo! Allah hath been a watcher over you.

explanation.bs: Muškarci i žene od jednog para – رِجَال nasuprot نِسَاء.
explanation.en: Men and women from one pair — rijāl as against nisāʾ.

quranTranslation.text: Had we appointed him (Our messenger) an angel, We assuredly had made him (as) a man (that he might speak to men); and (thus) obscured for them (the truth) they (now) obscure.

explanation.bs: Da je poslan melek, imao bi lik čovjeka-muškarca: رَجُل kao suprotnost meleku.
explanation.en: Had an angel been sent, he would have been made a man: rajul as the opposite of an angel.

quranTranslation.text: Men whom neither merchandise nor sale beguileth from remembrance of Allah and constancy in prayer and paying to the poor their due; who fear a day when hearts and eyeballs will be overturned;

explanation.bs: Ljudi koje trgovina ne odvraća od sjećanja na Allaha – množina koja hvali karakter.
explanation.en: Men whom trade does not distract from remembering Allah — a plural that praises character.

quranTranslation.text: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother

explanation.bs: Na Sudnjem danu svako bježi od svoga brata – čovjek kao pojedinac.
explanation.en: On the Day each one flees from his brother — man as an individual.

quranTranslation.text: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.

explanation.bs: Svaki je čovjek zalog onoga što je zaradio – lična odgovornost.
explanation.en: Every person is pledged for what he has earned — personal accountability.

quranTranslation.text: They ask thee for a pronouncement. Say: Allah hath pronounced for you concerning distant kindred. If a man die childless and he have a sister, hers is half the heritage, and he would have inherited from her had she died childless. And if there be two sisters, then theirs are two-thirds of the heritage, and if they be brethren, men and women, unto the male is the equivalent of the share of two females. Allah expoundeth unto you, so that ye err not. Allah is Knower of all things.

explanation.bs: Propis o nasljedstvu jedne osobe koja umre bez djeteta.
explanation.en: A ruling on the inheritance of one person who dies without a child.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.

explanation.bs: Obraćanje cijelom čovječanstvu, stvorenom od muškarca i žene.
explanation.en: An address to all mankind, created from a male and a female.

quranTranslation.text: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

explanation.bs: Gospodar svih ljudi – ljudi kao cjelina.
explanation.en: The Lord of mankind — people as a whole.

quranTranslation.text: And when it is said unto them: believe as the people believe, they say: shall we believe as the foolish believe? are not they indeed the foolish? But they know not.

explanation.bs: „Povjerujte kao što su ljudi povjerovali“: prema ar-Rāġibu, ovdje su to ljudi u kojima je istinska ljudskost, ljudi od vrijednosti.
explanation.en: “Believe as the people believe”: according to ar-Rāġib, here these are people in whom true humanity is found, people of worth.

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?

explanation.bs: „Zar nisi vidio šta je tvoj Gospodar učinio s vlasnicima slona?“ – فَعَلَ za Allahovo djelovanje.
explanation.en: “Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?” — فَعَلَ for Allah's doing.

quranTranslation.text: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?

explanation.bs: „Jesi li ti ovo učinio našim bogovima, Ibrahime?“ – pitanje o učinjenom činu.
explanation.en: “Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?” — a question about a deed done.

quranTranslation.text: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned.

explanation.bs: „On ne biva pitan za ono što čini“ – Allahovo djelovanje.
explanation.en: “He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth” — Allah's doing.

quranTranslation.text: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,

explanation.bs: „Pa ko uradi dobra koliko trun, vidjet će ga“ – namjerno djelo i njegova posljedica.
explanation.en: “Whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it” — a deliberate deed and its outcome.

quranTranslation.text: Say: I am only a mortal like you. My Lord inspireth in me that your Allah is only One Allah. And whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work, and make none sharer of the worship due unto his Lord.

explanation.bs: „Neka čini dobro djelo“ – glagol uz imenicu عَمَل.
explanation.en: “Let him do righteous work” — the verb with its noun عَمَل.

quranTranslation.text: They made for him what he willed: synagogues and statues, basins like wells and boilers built into the ground. Give thanks, O House of David! Few of My bondmen are thankful.

explanation.bs: Džini su Sulejmanu izrađivali šta je htio – عَمِلَ i za rad po nalogu.
explanation.en: The jinn made for Solomon what he willed — عَمِلَ also for work done to order.

quranTranslation.text: Build the ship under Our eyes and by Our inspiration, and speak not unto Me on behalf of those who do wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.

explanation.bs: „I napravi lađu pred Našim očima“ – Nuhova vješta izrada.
explanation.en: “Build the ship under Our eyes” — Noah's skilled work.

quranTranslation.text: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.

explanation.bs: Ono što su napravili samo je spletka vračara – izrada, ovdje vještina u obmani.
explanation.en: “That which they have made is but a wizard's artifice” — the making (ṣanaʿū) here is craft put to deception.

quranTranslation.text: Recite that which hath been inspired in thee of the Scripture, and establish worship. Lo! worship preserveth from lewdness and iniquity, but verily remembrance of Allah is more important. And Allah knoweth what ye do.

explanation.bs: „A Allah zna šta činite“ – i opće značenje: ono što ljudi čine.
explanation.en: “And Allah knoweth what ye do” — the general sense too: what people do.

quranTranslation.text: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?

explanation.bs: „Zar čovjek misli da Mi njegove kosti nećemo sakupiti?“ – spajanje dijelova.
explanation.en: “Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?” — bringing parts together.

quranTranslation.text: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.

explanation.bs: Onaj ko gomila imetak i prebrojava ga – جَمَعَ za imetak.
explanation.en: Who collects wealth and counts it — جَمَعَ for wealth.

quranTranslation.text: The day when He shall gather you unto the Day of Assembling, that will be a day of mutual disillusion. And whoso believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will remit from him his evil deeds and will bring him unto Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. That is the supreme triumph.

explanation.bs: „Dan kada vas On sakupi za Dan sakupljanja“ – i جَمَعَ se kaže za Sudnji dan.
explanation.en: “The day when He shall gather you unto the Day of Assembling” — جَمَعَ is said of the Last Day too.

quranTranslation.text: (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high.

explanation.bs: Musa: „i neka ljudi budu okupljeni u prijepodne“ – okupljanje mnoštva na jedno mjesto.
explanation.en: Moses: “let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high” — a multitude brought to one place.

quranTranslation.text: And when the wild beasts are herded together,

explanation.bs: „I kad divlje zvijeri budu okupljene“ – mnoštvo dovedeno na jedno mjesto.
explanation.en: “And when the wild beasts are herded together” — a multitude brought to one place.

quranTranslation.text: He will say: My Lord! Wherefor hast Thou gathered me (hither) blind, when I was wont to see?

explanation.bs: „Gospodaru moj, zašto si me slijepog doveo (حَشَرْتَنِي)…?“ – حَشَرَ za pojedinca, protivprimjer pravilu.
explanation.en: “My Lord! Wherefor hast Thou gathered me (hither) blind” (حَشَرْتَنِي) — حَشَرَ of one person, a counter-example to the rule.

quranTranslation.text: And let not those who hoard up that which Allah hath bestowed upon them of His bounty think that it is better for them. Nay, it is worse for them. That which they hoard will be their collar on the Day of Resurrection. Allah's is the heritage of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is Informed of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „Neka ne misle oni koji su škrti s onim što im je Allah iz Svoje dobrote podario da je to za njih dobro – naprotiv, to je za njih zlo.“
explanation.en: “And let not those who hoard up that which Allah hath bestowed upon them of His bounty think that it is better for them. Nay, it is worse for them.”

quranTranslation.text: Lo! ye are those who are called to spend in the way of Allah, yet among you there are some who hoard. And as for him who hoardeth, he hoardeth only from his soul. And Allah is the Rich, and ye are the poor. And if ye turn away He will exchange you for some other folk, and they will not be the likes of you.

explanation.bs: „A ko škrtari, škrtari samo protiv sebe“ – uskraćivanje se vraća onome ko uskraćuje.
explanation.en: “And as for him who hoardeth, he hoardeth only from his soul” — the withholding returns on the one who withholds.

quranTranslation.text: Who hoard their wealth and enjoin avarice on others, and hide that which Allah hath bestowed upon them of His bounty. For disbelievers We prepare a shameful doom;

explanation.bs: „Oni koji škrtare, i ljudima nalažu škrtost, i taje ono čime ih je Allah iz Svoje dobrote obdario.“
explanation.en: “Who hoard their wealth and enjoin avarice on others, and hide that which Allah hath bestowed upon them of His bounty.”

quranTranslation.text: Who hoard and who enjoin upon the people avarice. And whosoever turneth away, still Allah is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.

explanation.bs: „Oni koji škrtare i ljudima naređuju škrtost“ – isti izraz, drugi put.
explanation.en: “Who hoard and who enjoin upon the people avarice” — the same phrase, the second time.

quranTranslation.text: If a woman feareth ill treatment from her husband, or desertion, it is no sin for them twain if they make terms of peace between themselves. Peace is better. But greed hath been made present in the minds (of men). If ye do good and keep from evil, lo! Allah is ever Informed of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „A lakomost je dušama stalno prisutna“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “But greed hath been made present in the minds (of men)” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Those who entered the city and the faith before them love those who flee unto them for refuge, and find in their breasts no need for that which hath been given them, but prefer (the fugitives) above themselves though poverty become their lot. And whoso is saved from his own avarice - such are they who are successful.

explanation.bs: „A ko bude sačuvan od lakomosti svoje duše – takvi su ti koji uspijevaju.“
explanation.en: “And whoso is saved from his own avarice - such are they who are successful.”

quranTranslation.text: Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed.

explanation.bs: „Zar je onaj koji tokom noćnih sati pokorno ibadet čini … koji se čuva ahireta i nada se milosti svoga Gospodara [isti kao onaj koji to ne čini]?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night … bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)?” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Lo! among your wives and your children there are enemies for you, therefor beware of them. And if ye efface and overlook and forgive, then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „O vi koji vjerujete, neki od vaših supruga i vaše djece neprijatelji su vam, pa se od njih čuvajte! A ako budete praštali … Allah, zaista, prašta“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! Lo! among your wives and your children there are enemies for you, therefor beware of them. And if ye efface … then lo! Allah is Forgiving” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: The hypocrites fear lest a surah should be revealed concerning them, proclaiming what is in their hearts. Say: Scoff (your fill)! Lo! Allah is disclosing what ye fear.

explanation.bs: „Licemjeri se čuvaju da im se ne objavi sura koja će ih obavijestiti o onome što je u njihovim srcima.“
explanation.en: “The hypocrites fear lest a surah should be revealed concerning them, proclaiming what is in their hearts.”

quranTranslation.text: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom).

explanation.bs: „Oni koji se boje svoga Gospodara iako Ga ne vide, i koji od Časa strepe“ – s min: jače se čuje strah; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour” — with min: the fear is heard more; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;

explanation.bs: Stanovnici Dženneta: „Mi smo, zaista, ranije među svojom porodicom strepili“ – s fī: briga za porodicu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: The people of Paradise: “Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious” — with fī: care for one's family; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Those who believe not therein seek to hasten it, while those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the Truth. Are not they who dispute, in doubt concerning the Hour, far astray?

explanation.bs: „… a oni koji vjeruju strepe od njega [Časa], znajući da je on istina“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… while those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the Truth” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: They only are the (true) believers whose hearts feel fear when Allah is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited unto them they increase their faith, and who trust in their Lord;

explanation.bs: „Vjernici su samo oni kojima, kad se Allah spomene, srca zadrhte“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “They only are the (true) believers whose hearts feel fear when Allah is mentioned” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Whose hearts fear when Allah is mentioned, and the patient of whatever may befall them, and those who establish worship and who spend of that We have bestowed on them.

explanation.bs: „… one kojima, kad se Allah spomene, srca zadrhte, i one strpljive u onome što ih pogodi.“
explanation.en: “Whose hearts fear when Allah is mentioned, and the patient of whatever may befall them.”

quranTranslation.text: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.

explanation.bs: Meleki, Ibrahimovi gosti, rekoše mu: „Ne drhti, mi te radujemo viješću o dječaku koji će mnogo znati“; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: The angels, Abraham's guests, said to him: “Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom”; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Who is it that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, so that He may give it increase manifold? Allah straiteneth and enlargeth. Unto Him ye will return.

explanation.bs: „Allah uskraćuje (يَقْبِضُ) i proširuje“ – ar-Rāġib navodi više tumačenja: oduzima pa daje, jednima oduzima a drugima daje, ili usmrćuje i oživljava; kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Allah straiteneth (يَقْبِضُ) and enlargeth” — ar-Rāġib gives several readings: He takes away and gives, takes from some and gives to others, or causes death and gives life; as befits Him.

gloss.en: to clench, to draw in, to withhold

quranTranslation.text: The hypocrites, both men and women, proceed one from another. They enjoin the wrong, and they forbid the right, and they withhold their hands (from spending for the cause of Allah). They forget Allah, so He hath forgotten them. Lo! the hypocrites, they are the transgressors.

explanation.bs: Licemjeri „stežu (يَقْبِضُونَ) svoje ruke“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, ustežu se od trošenja.
explanation.en: The hypocrites “withhold (يَقْبِضُونَ) their hands” — according to ar-Rāġib, they refrain from spending.

gloss.en: to clench, to draw in, to withhold

quranTranslation.text: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things.

explanation.bs: Ptice nad njima, „kako šire krila i skupljaju ih (يَقْبِضْنَ)“ – skupljanje; a drži ih samo Milostivi (أَمْسَكَ).
explanation.en: The birds above them, “spreading out their wings and closing them (يَقْبِضْنَ)” — drawing in; and none holds them up but the Most Merciful (أَمْسَكَ).

gloss.en: to clench, to draw in, to withhold

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah graspeth the heavens and the earth that they deviate not, and if they were to deviate there is not one that could grasp them after Him. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.

explanation.bs: „Allah, zaista, drži (يُمْسِكُ) nebesa i Zemlju da ne nestanu“ – drži i čuva, kako Njemu priliči (ar-Rāġib tako tumači 22:65).
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah graspeth (يُمْسِكُ) the heavens and the earth that they deviate not” — holds and preserves, as befits Him (so ar-Rāġib explains 22:65).

quranTranslation.text: Then, when they have reached their term, take them back in kindness or part from them in kindness, and call to witness two just men among you, and keep your testimony upright for Allah. Whoso believeth in Allah and the Last Day is exhorted to act thus. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, Allah will appoint a way out for him,

explanation.bs: „A kad dođu do kraja svoga roka, zadržite ih (أَمْسِكُوهُنَّ) na lijep način ili se od njih na lijep način rastavite“ – zadržati u braku.
explanation.en: “Then, when they have reached their term, take them back (أَمْسِكُوهُنَّ) in kindness or part from them in kindness” — keeping in marriage.

quranTranslation.text: Say (unto them): If ye possessed the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, ye would surely hold them back for fear of spending, for man was ever grudging.

explanation.bs: „Kad biste vi posjedovali riznice milosti moga Gospodara, sigurno biste ih zadržali (أَمْسَكْتُمْ) iz straha od trošenja“ – zadržavanje kao škrtost.
explanation.en: “If ye possessed the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, ye would surely hold them back (أَمْسَكْتُمْ) for fear of spending” — holding back as stinginess.

quranTranslation.text: We found no (loyalty to any) covenant in most of them. Nay, most of them We found wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „Nismo našli da većina njih drži do zavjeta, nego smo našli da su većinom nepokorni“ – Allahovo nalaženje je znanje; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “We found no (loyalty to any) covenant in most of them. Nay, most of them We found wrong-doers” — Allah's finding is knowledge; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne.

explanation.bs: Pupavac Sulejmanu: „Našao sam, zaista, ženu koja njima vlada“ – ar-Rāġib: nalaženje i okom i razumom, jer je pupavac o njima i prosudio.
explanation.en: The hoopoe to Solomon: “Lo! I found a woman ruling over them” — ar-Rāġib: finding by sight and by insight, for the hoopoe went on to judge their state.

quranTranslation.text: And when it is said unto them: Come unto that which Allah hath revealed and unto the messenger, they say: Enough for us is that wherein we found our fathers. What! Even though their fathers had no knowledge whatsoever, and no guidance?

explanation.bs: „Nama je dovoljno ono na čemu smo našli svoje očeve“ – ista rečenica kao u 2:170, ali s wajada.
explanation.en: “Enough for us is that wherein we found our fathers” — the same saying as in 2:170, but with wajada.

quranTranslation.text: And when it is said unto them: Follow that which Allah hath revealed, they say: We follow that wherein we found our fathers. What! Even though their fathers were wholly unintelligent and had no guidance?

explanation.bs: „Ne, nego ćemo se držati onoga na čemu smo zatekli svoje očeve“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “We follow that wherein we found [alfaynā] our fathers” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And they raced with one another to the door, and she tore his shirt from behind, and they met her lord and master at the door. She said: What shall be his reward, who wisheth evil to thy folk, save prison or a painful doom?

explanation.bs: „… i kod vrata zatekoše gospodara njenog“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… and they met her lord and master at the door” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: They indeed found their fathers astray,

explanation.bs: „Oni su, zaista, zatekli očeve svoje u zabludi.“
explanation.en: “They indeed found their fathers astray.”

quranTranslation.text: Then, even after that, your hearts were hardened and became as rocks, or worse than rocks, for hardness. For indeed there are rocks from out which rivers gush, and indeed there are rocks which split asunder so that water floweth from them. And indeed there are rocks which fall down for the fear of Allah. Allah is not unaware of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „Zatim su vam nakon toga otvrdnula srca, pa su kao kamenje, ili još tvrđa …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Then, even after that, your hearts were hardened and became as rocks, or worse than rocks, for hardness” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: If only, when Our disaster came on them, they had been humble! But their hearts were hardened and the devil made all that they used to do seem fair unto them!

explanation.bs: „Pa zašto se nisu ponizili kad im je došla Naša kazna? Ali, srca su im otvrdnula …“ – srce koje ni nevolja ne omekša.
explanation.en: “If only, when Our disaster came on them, they had been humble! But their hearts were hardened” — a heart that even hardship does not soften.

quranTranslation.text: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers.

explanation.bs: „… i da ne budu kao oni kojima je ranije data Knjiga, pa im se vrijeme oduljilo i srca im otvrdnula …“ – opomena vjernicima.
explanation.en: “that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened” — a warning to the believers.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Fight those of the disbelievers who are near to you, and let them find harshness in you, and know that Allah is with those who keep their duty (unto Him).

explanation.bs: „O vjernici, borite se s onima među nevjernicima koji su vam najbliži, i neka u vama nađu grubost …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! Fight those of the disbelievers who are near to you, and let them find harshness in you” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: We give them comfort for a little, and then We drive them to a heavy doom.

explanation.bs: „Dajemo im da malo uživaju, a zatim ih nagonimo u tešku kaznu“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “We give them comfort for a little, and then We drive them to a heavy doom” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: How can ye take it (back) after one of you hath gone in unto the other, and they have taken a strong pledge from you?

explanation.bs: „… a one su od vas uzele čvrst zavjet“ – bračni zavjet, ‚čvrst‘ u prenesenom značenju.
explanation.en: “and they have taken a strong pledge from you” — the marriage pledge, ‘firm’ in a borrowed sense.

quranTranslation.text: It was by the mercy of Allah that thou wast lenient with them (O Muhammad), for if thou hadst been stern and fierce of heart they would have dispersed from round about thee. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult with them upon the conduct of affairs. And when thou art resolved, then put thy trust in Allah. Lo! Allah loveth those who put their trust (in Him).

explanation.bs: „Po milosti Allahovoj postupao si s njima blago; da si bio osoran i tvrda srca, raspršili bi se oko tebe …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; osornost se ovdje od Poslanika odriče.
explanation.en: “It was by the mercy of Allah that thou wast lenient with them (O Muhammad), for if thou hadst been stern and fierce of heart they would have dispersed from round about thee” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; rudeness is here denied of the Prophet.
